messages.title: PixelShelf V2.0 - Coming Soon
messages.body:
What's new in PixelShelf V2.0

A fresh new look and more features:

• New look: glass cards, soft shadows and smoother animations throughout.
• Add and Quick Add redesigned, with per-game details and a slicker add animation.
• Deeper integration between pages.
• Game Detail reworked, with tabs and better visuals
• New rich progress tracking for XBOX and Steam.
• Game series information, recommendations and time to beat.
• Screenshots and build in video player for the games in your library.
• Notes now support bullets, multi-line text and photos

Coming Soon!
